author: Cinna Davis with OpenAI Codex assistance
statement: For every h >= 2, explicit symmetric and antisymmetric hook entries of the full partition-space uncharged crossing family yield shift-span rank at least 2h-1; a codebook containing the reference states and q hooks inherits rank at least 2q-1. On energy E the all-ones label slice obeys Q_s=Q_-s and sum_s (s^2-4hE) Q_s=0, bounding its rank by 2h at E=h.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the all-size argument
Determine full 4h rank for all h or locate further relations
Establish actual lexicographic codebook coverage and all recursive costs for any algorithmic proposal
